spec.low: floor close <= 1.15 * prior 500-session minimum close; at least 250 prior bars
spec.rally: last 60-session peak after a 5-60 bar rally of >=15% from prior 90-bar low
spec.volume: rally average > both pre-floor 5 and 10-bar means
spec.pullback: 5-30 bars, price decline 5%-30%, retrace 20%-85%, no close below floor
spec.wash_volume: last 5 pullback bars mean <=70% of rally mean; whole-pullback mean retained for diagnosis
spec.extreme: 3-bar mean <=40% of rally mean AND <=50% of preceding 20-bar mean; current volume <= previous 10-bar minimum
spec.entry: signal confirmed after close; next market session open; upper-limit opens skipped
spec.exit: entry is day1; scheduled close; locked lower-limit/suspension delays to first sellable open
spec.dedup: first qualifying signal per stock/floor/peak; then exclude overlapping same-stock trades per horizon
spec.stop: none; fixed horizon isolates the new entry pattern
spec.warning: retrospective, surviving TDX universe; daily execution estimate; total-return adjustment approximation
